description: This file contains JavaScript code associated with Material Design for Bootstrap (MDB), supporting various plugins, libraries, and utility functions used for frontend UI/UX enhancements in a web project. It includes licensing info, references to external libraries (such as jQuery, Chart.js), custom easing functions, velocity animations, and color manipulation utilities.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: A class for parsing, manipulating, and converting color representations between RGB, HSL, HSV, HWB, CMYK, and others, including string output methods.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: A class for managing visual elements with properties, transitions, and interpolations used for chart components.

classes.name: Legend
classes.description: Class managing the legend component's lifecycle, appearance, and event handling within the chart.

classes.name: Title
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering and positioning the chart title.

methods.name: getRgba
methods.description: Parses a color string and returns an RGBA array.

methods.name: getHsla
methods.description: Parses a HSLA color string and returns an HSLA array.

methods.name: hexString
methods.description: Converts an RGB array to a hexadecimal color string.

methods.name: rgbString
methods.description: Converts an RGBA array to an RGB or RGBA string.

methods.name: rgbaString
methods.description: Converts an RGBA array to an RGBA string.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Interpolates properties of chart elements between start and target states, considering easing and color blending.

methods.name: Element.prototype.pivot
methods.description: Prepares the element for a transition by copying current properties to a view.

methods.name: Element.prototype.transition
methods.description: Animates the element's properties towards the view's target state based on easing.

methods.name: Element.prototype.tooltipPosition
methods.description: Returns the current position of the element for tooltip placement.

methods.name: Element.prototype.hasValue
methods.description: Checks whether the element has valid numeric x and y values.

methods.name: getRelativePosition
methods.description: Calculates relative mouse/touch position within a canvas element, considering device pixel ratio and padding.

methods.name: parseMaxStyle
methods.description: Converts max-width/max-height CSS style values, including percentages, into pixel values based on parent dimensions.

methods.name: isConstrainedValue
methods.description: Checks if a given style value effectively constrains size, ignoring 'none' or undefined.

methods.name: getConstraintDimension
methods.description: Determines the constraint dimension (width/height) of a DOM node based on computed styles and parent dimensions.

methods.name: helpers.getConstraintWidth
methods.description: Returns maximum width constraint for a DOM node.

methods.name: helpers.getConstraintHeight
methods.description: Returns maximum height constraint for a DOM node.

methods.name: helpers._calculatePadding
methods.description: Calculates padding value, supporting percentages relative to parent dimension.

methods.name: helpers._getParentNode
methods.description: Retrieves the parent node, supporting shadow DOM hosts.

methods.name: helpers.getMaximumWidth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum width available for a DOM node considering parent constraints.

methods.name: helpers.getMaximumHeight
methods.description: Calculates the maximum height available for a DOM node considering parent constraints.

methods.name: helpers.getStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the computed style property value of a DOM element.

methods.name: helpers.retinaScale
methods.description: Adjusts canvas size and scaling for retina/high-DPI devices, updating the chart's context scale.

methods.name: helpers.fontString
methods.description: Constructs a CSS font string from pixel size, style, and font family.

methods.name: helpers.longestText
methods.description: Measures and caches the width of the longest text string among an array of strings or labels.

methods.name: helpers.measureText
methods.description: Measures the width of a single text string, utilizing cache.

methods.name: helpers.numberOfLabelLines
methods.description: Counts multi-line labels to determine the number of lines.

methods.name: helpers.color
methods.description: A color utility function, fallback to console error if color library not loaded.

methods.name: helpers.getHoverColor
methods.description: Generates a hover color by saturating and darkening the input color.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the entire canvas associated to the given chart.

methods.name: roundedRect
methods.description: Creates a path for a rectangle with rounded corners at specified position and size, with optional corner radius.

methods.name: drawPoint
methods.description: Draws a point of specified style and size at given coordinates; supports images and various shapes.

methods.name: clipArea
methods.description: Saves canvas state and sets clipping region to specified rectangle area.

methods.name: unclipArea
methods.description: Restores canvas to previous state, removing clipping region.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Draws a line or bezier curve between points, supporting stepped lines and curves.

methods.name: determineDataLimits
methods.description: Calculates data bounds for scales, considering stacking and axis labels.

methods.name: buildTicks
methods.description: Generates tick values based on labels and scale options.

methods.name: getLabelForIndex
methods.description: Retrieves label string for a given tick index, handling horizontal and vertical scales.

methods.name: getPixelForValue
methods.description: Converts a data value into pixel coordinate for rendering.

methods.name: getPixelForTick
methods.description: Returns pixel coordinate for a specific tick index.

methods.name: getValueForPixel
methods.description: Converts a pixel coordinate back into a data value.

methods.name: getBasePixel
methods.description: Returns the pixel position corresponding to the base (zero) of the scale.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Main update method for the chart, including layout, labels, and fitting.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the chart title or legend element on the canvas.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Processes user interaction events like mouse hover or click for the legend.
